hero.title: Zcash Leads Crypto Bounce, Surging 8.5% as Bitcoin Reclaims $83,000
hero.description: Zcash jumped 8.5% in 24 hours to $1,215.85 as the broader crypto market rebounded, with Bitcoin up 1.6% and ETF money flowing back in.
